from datetime import datetime

# Parse the user's checkout date
checkout_date_str = "May 18, 2025"
checkout_date = datetime.strptime(checkout_date_str, "%B %d, %Y")

# The user wants to check out on May 18, 2025, but the flight is on June 1, 2025.
# This means the hotel stay is in the past relative to the flight, which is unusual.
# However, we will proceed with the dates as provided by the user.
# Check-in date is not explicitly provided, but typically check-in is the day before checkout.
# We will assume check-in is May 17, 2025 (one day before checkout).
checkin_date_str = "May 17, 2025"
checkin_date = datetime.strptime(checkin_date_str, "%B %d, %Y")

# Adjust check-in date to be one day before checkout
checkin_date = checkout_date - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
checkin_date_str = checkin_date.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# Adjust checkout date to be one day after check-in
checkout_date = checkin_date + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
checkout_date_str = checkout_date.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# Search for hotels in Anchorage with free breakfast
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="Anchorage",
    checkin_date=[checkin_date_str],
    checkout_date=[checkout_date_str],
    breakfast_included=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)
